model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (revision 989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306 per STATUS_air_kaggle_zh.md), model.safetensors sha256 dd924a11b4c220f385b51ffa522daea7c9f3d850e31b162bb5661df483c6d3ee, bf16, sdpa, MPS. The only local copy with weights sits in a macOS temp folder; ~/paper_project/models/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct has no weights.
fixed_a_priori: Fixed a priori, not tuned: a fork is a code position (outside comments and docstrings) where some other token has at least a quarter of the top token's probability (log ratio <= ln 4), up to 2 alternatives; flec/likelihood visit at most 4 forks in increasing-margin order; flec, likelihood and best_of_n may spend at most 2x the greedy program's generated length in extra model positions; contrast lambda = 1; plan allowance 96 tokens; cap 192 tokens as in the harness.
compute_unit: model positions: prompt prefill + decode steps + auxiliary streams; KV reuse allowed for every arm; visible-test executions counted separately
evidence: every arm sees the identical task text and the first assert (visible test); other asserts are hidden, used only for offline labels; the engine refuses any decoder input containing a hidden assert
purpose: Same-prefix branch replay on the 16 MBPP development rows: oracle headroom of single-fork steering, and which signal (greedy token, mean log-prob, USCD-like example contrast, visible-test execution) picks the hidden-correct branch at decisive forks.
gate_rule: Run Stage 1-2 only if G0 (>=3/16 items where greedy is hidden-wrong and some single-fork completion is hidden-correct) and G1 (simulated flec minus simulated likelihood control >= 2 items) both pass. G0 fail: one-fork steering has too little headroom on this workload; switch mechanism or workload, do not tune cutoffs. G1 fail: the task-grounded choice does not beat confidence; stop.
